text: Studio (eyes4s-7e) answers, 2026-09-26. (1) Participant value = mean of per-query differences (ParticipantMeans, equal weight). PooledQueries is named and never the default. (2) A within-participant LevelContrast is included (e.g. Remembered - Forgotten), with paired n. (3) Numeric covariates group only through declared Bins. (4) minimumQueries drops a participant from that group only, reported as BelowMinimum. (5) Dispersion: report n + SD by default; SEM is optional; no inferential interval by default (the MVP ships none). A t-based CI may exist only as a named, non-default option. Design sketch: /private/tmp/eyes4s-shared/UI-C-reportspec-sketch.md (new pure eyes4s-results module).
